services.value: Eurofins Built Environment Testing provides built environment services including Industrial Hygiene (IH) and Indoor Air Quality (IAQ) testing, with analyses for asbestos, mold, lead, silica, welding fume/hexavalent chromium, VOC’s, PCB’s, formaldehyde, and Legionella, among much more. The text also lists specific lab analysis services such as allergen ELISA testing, asbestos testing (air and bulk), bacteria testing (E. coli and Legionella), mold testing (culturable air, direct exam, and spore trap), PCR testing (including ERMI), radon lab analysis (using the E-Perm system), and USP 797 testing and compliance through environmental monitoring.
